bootstrap_change_reason: This checkout changes router-update to persist and enforce the monotonic installed version floor, fence interrupted full installations, verify runtime rollback compatibility, and share bounded startup budgets. Firstboot admission and dispatcher integration also changed. router-recovery continues to share canonical configuration validation. Published v0.1.7 and earlier appliances require the newly signed full distribution installer once; the existing v0.1.7 ISO is not evidence for these working-tree changes. Normal A/B activation still requires byte-identical installed bootstrap and integration files. router-setup now participates in firstboot admission, so it is also built deterministically and byte-compared as installed integration.
deterministic_bootstrap_note: Releases up to and including v0.1.6 were built without -buildvcs=false, so Go stamped the
commit hash and derived module version into the bootstrap binaries. Two such releases can
never be byte-identical, which made web updates between published releases impossible for a
reason unrelated to compatibility: v0.1.5 and v0.1.6 differ only in vcs.revision, vcs.time and
the module version string. From the first release built with GO_BOOTSTRAP_BUILD_FLAGS, the
bytes depend on bootstrap source and toolchain only.
